verdict: Bullish LT signals (HBM prices multiples higher in 2027, MRVL ATH on NVIDIA $2B endorsement, CIEN beat-and-raise) but AVGO guide miss triggered SOX -10.3% -- largest chip selloff since Mar 2020; reads as macro reset, not fundamental AI capex crack
body_md:
## Fresh Developments (last 24-72h)

**Signal 1 - DRAM/HBM Pricing (BULL):** TrendForce Jun 2: HBM contract prices set to surge "multiples higher" in 2027 as suppliers seize absolute pricing power. Key twist: DDR5 64GB RDIMM profitability *overtook* HBM3e in Q1-2026, forcing suppliers to reprice HBM aggressively upward to rebalance. Q1-2026 DRAM industry revenue +81% QoQ; 2Q26 DDR5 +63% QoQ forecast.

**Signal 2 - HBM4 Ramp:** No fresh correction signal. HBM wafer share of total DRAM rising 18% (2025) -> 22% (2026) -> ~30% (2027). NVIDIA Rubin Ultra platform pushes per-GPU HBM to 384 GB in 2027, amplifying bit demand further.

**Signal 3 - Hyperscaler Capex:** Quiet; no guide-down. Aggregate 2026 capex ~$725B on-track (AMZN $200B, GOOGL $190B, MSFT $145B, META $115-135B).

**Signal 4 - AMD/Custom ASIC:** No fresh 24-72h news. AVGO earnings call (Jun 3) confirmed 6 custom chip customers including Anthropic, Google, Meta, OpenAI.

**Signal 5 - Optical (BULL):** Jun 2 Computex: Jensen Huang made bullish optics comments and NVIDIA announced $2B investment in Coherent. COHR +17.66% to ATH; LITE +14%. Jun 4: CIEN Q2 beat-and-raise -- rev $1.57B (est $1.53B), EPS $1.64 (est $1.40), FY2026 guidance raised to $6.3B (+32% YoY).

**Signal 6 - Solar:** Section 232 polysilicon tariff decision pending, expected by "end of month." US module prices $0.28/W with upward pressure. FSLR positioned as beneficiary (CdTe, no silicon exposure). No ENPH/NXT/ARRY-specific catalysts.

No notable movers: AMD, ALAB, CRDO, RMBS, MRAM, SNDK, WDC, STX, NOW, ZS, CRM, SNOW, TSLA, GDDY, NOK, AMPX, ALMU, NXT, ARRY, ENPH, FSLR in last 24-72h.

---

## Context vs Baseline

Baseline (May 28) flagged SK Hynix "correction risk after 2026." TrendForce Jun 2 runs directly counter -- HBM prices seen multiples higher in 2027 on structural supply crowding-out and Rubin Ultra bit-demand surge. The AVGO guide miss is the most important near-term bear signal: it does NOT confirm AI capex slowdown (CIEN beat, MRVL ATH, hyperscalers reaffirmed) and the SOX drop looks macro/rate-driven. But one more guidance miss from a bellwether would materially test cycle conviction.

## Most Important Development

**AVGO guide miss + SOX -10.3% selloff (Jun 4-5):** Broadcom's Q3 revenue guidance of $29.4B (vs $37.5B consensus) and no raise to its $100B AI FY2026 target triggered the largest chip-index down-day since March 2020. Counterweights -- CIEN beat-and-raise, MRVL all-time-high on direct NVIDIA endorsement, TrendForce's bullish HBM 2027 pricing call -- argue this is a sentiment/macro reset, not a fundamental inflection. Watch dip-buying behavior this week.

*Not investment advice. Forward figures are forecasts.*
